title: Home

editing.hint: Drag a widget to move it, and pull its corner to resize it.
editing.hintStacked: Move widgets up and down, or remove what you don't need.

tooLarge: Your home page is full. Remove a widget to make room.

empty.title: Your home page is empty
empty.description: Add the widgets you want to see first, or start from a layout.

picker.title: Add a widget
picker.description: It goes at the bottom of your page. Move it wherever you like.

layouts.newDescription: Start from one of these, or from nothing. It opens as a new tab beside your other views, and you can change anything about it.
layouts.fillDescription: Fill this view with one of these. You can change anything about it afterwards.

tasks.name: My tasks
tasks.description: Everything assigned to you, with what needs doing now on top.

myDay.name: My day
myDay.description: Your own planner: what needs doing now, the days ahead, your streak, then the whole list.

headsDown.name: Heads down
headsDown.description: A timer and the few things that need doing now. Nothing else to look at.

assigned.name: Assigned work
assigned.description: Your list first, the urgent part beside it, and what's happened to your things lately.

community.name: Community
community.description: Keep up with the communities you follow and what's happening in them.

owner.name: Running the show
owner.description: What's moving in your community, what you bookmarked and what changed in projects and dashboards, and your own list.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: Hello, today's date, and how much is due.
greeting.yonderHint: He reads the day for you: puzzled by anything late, delighted by a clear one.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: A few first things to do, ticked off as you do them.
gettingStarted.allDone: That's everything. You're all set, and this card can go whenever you like.

intro.personal: This is your home. Let's get your space feeling lived in.
intro.shared: Your community is ready. Here's how to get people into it.
intro.join: Welcome! First things first: let's find you some people.
intro.invite: You're in. Here are a few things worth doing first.

community.invite: Join the community you were invited to
community.hint: Communities are where the work and the people are.

task.title: Add a task of your own
task.hint: Anything you need to remember. It lands in My tasks.
task.hintList: Add one to {{list}}. It lands in My tasks.

invite.title: Invite your people
invite.hint: A community of one is a very quiet community.

profile.title: Add a profile picture
profile.hint: So people know it's you in comments and on tasks.

app.title: Get the app
app.hint: Your tasks and messages, in your pocket.

home.title: Make this page yours
home.hint: Move things about, add a clock or a calendar, or make a second view.

focus.title: Focus
focus.description: What needs doing now, with today's finished work kept in view.

tasks.title: My tasks
tasks.description: Your tasks from every community, as a table.
tasks.empty: Nothing is assigned to you yet. When someone gives you a task, or you add one of your own, it lands here.
tasks.chooseList: Choose a list to add to
tasks.addToHint: Shows a line at the top for adding a task to this list, assigned to you.
tasks.noList: Don't show a line for adding tasks

comingUp.title: Coming up
comingUp.description: Events and task dates in the days ahead, from every community.
comingUp.empty_other: Nothing coming up in the next {{count}} days.

calendar.title: My calendar
calendar.description: Your events and dated tasks from every community, by month or week. The same calendar as My Calendar.

recent.title: Recent
recent.description: What you opened lately, or what changed lately, across every kind of tool and every community.
recent.toolsHint: Narrow both lists to these kinds of tool. Leave it empty for all of them.
recent.emptyViewed: Nothing opened yet. Projects, files and the rest show up here once you've looked at them.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: Everything you bookmarked, from every community, a click away.
bookmarks.toolsHint: Show only these kinds of tool. Leave it empty for all of them.
bookmarks.empty: Nothing bookmarked yet. Bookmark a project, a file or anything else from its page, and it waits for you here.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: What people changed lately in one of your communities.
activity.noCommunity: Join a community to see what's happening in it.

communities.title: My communities
communities.description: Every community you're in, as its card.
communities.empty: You're not in a community yet.

progress.title: My progress
progress.description: Your streak, your week, and how much lands on time.
progress.firstTask: Finish your first task to start a streak.

clock.title: Clock and timer
clock.description: The time here and elsewhere, or a countdown for the thing you said would take ten minutes.
clock.typeLengthOf: Timer set to {{length}}. Click to type a different length.

views.label: Your home views
views.limit: You can keep up to {{max}} views.
views.deleteDescription: Its widgets go with it. Nothing in your communities is touched.

blank.name: Blank
blank.description: An empty page to fill however you like.

marketplace.empty: No layouts in the marketplace yet.

store.title: Home layouts
store.description: Pages of widgets made for different kinds of day. Add one and it opens as a new view on your home page; the views you have stay as they are.

banner.title: This view's banner
banner.description: Any banner you have can sit at the top of this view, and each view can wear a different one.
